fields.description:
## Source of truth

https://jumpr.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/JK/pages/269090817/03+User+Stories+Jira+Disposition

## Outcome

Once a Deal crosses first activation, its integration identity cannot drift even when current Status later becomes Paused, Inactive, Closed or Archived.

## Never activated / Draft

When First Activated Date is blank:

* approved makeup changes may regenerate Makeup Key + External Deal ID using the existing identity/collision logic;
* unrelated edits do not regenerate identity;
* the Deal may be deleted subject to the existing related-Signup safety rule.

## Ever activated

Once First Activated Date is populated:

* ordinary saves do not regenerate External Deal ID or Makeup Key;
* normal user/API paths cannot change Operator, Partner, Market Country, Market State, Vertical, Source, External Deal ID or system identity fields;
* normal users cannot physically delete the Deal;
* missing/corrupt protected identity values require explicit remediation.

## Archived

* Archived remains historically identity-locked.
* The controlled Archive process may rewrite **Makeup Key only** to release the raw makeup.
* External Deal ID never changes.
* Later CMS/audit/Notes saves preserve the Archived key and External Deal ID.

## Acceptance criteria

1. Draft makeup change regenerates identity through the existing generator.
2. Draft unrelated edit does not.
3. Active → Paused/Inactive/Closed preserves identity.
4. Archived key release does not change External Deal ID.
5. Standard user/API cannot bypass protected makeup/identity fields after first activation.
6. Ever-activated Deal cannot be physically deleted by a standard user.
